## Relationships

### [Evadne](../character/evadne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/evadne--perceval.md)

Perceval and [Evadne](../character/evadne.md) are depicted as romantic partners within a fictional story written by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Their relationship exists as a narrative dynamic crafted by the author in that tale.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022)_

- Romantically involved with — fictional romantic partners in a story  <sub>[v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022)</sub>

### [Marcel Lennox](../character/marcel-lennox.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marcel-lennox--perceval.md)

Perceval and [Marcel Lennox](../character/marcel-lennox.md) act as rival suitors competing for Evadne's affections. This competitive dynamic forms their connection within the context of Nell's story.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P47](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0047)_

- Rival of — rival suitors for Evadne's affection in Nell's story  <sub>[v3 ch.Atonement” P47](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0047)</sub>
